description: Searches the legal acts of Georgia in the Legislative Herald (matsne.gov.ge): laws, codes, resolutions, decrees, orders, treaties, and court decisions. Returns 20 acts on a page, each with its identifier, title, document type, issuer, number, signing date, and status, and the total count. The source has no order by relevance: give a type, a status, or an issuer to bring an act to the first page. A Georgian query that equals the full title of an active act puts that act first. Search in Georgian for the best match; an English query matches the titles of translated acts only. Call law_get_act with the identifier to read the act. Data from the Legislative Herald of Georgia.

issuer.description: The body that adopted the act, in the language of the request, for example Parliament of Georgia.

language.description: The language of the titles: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of acts of the page, 1 to 20. The default is 20.

number.description: The number of the act, for example 3591.

order.description: newest or oldest signing date first. The default is newest.

page.description: The page of 20 results, from 1. The default is 1.

query.description: The text to find, 1 to 128 characters. Georgian finds every act; English finds translated acts only.

status.description: The status of the act: active, expired, or pending.

target.description: Where to search: title or text. The default is title.

type.description: A document type: law, parliament_resolution, presidential_decree, government_resolution, government_decree, edict, order, international_treaty, constitutional_court_decision, court_act, self_government_ordinance, self_government_decision, revenue_service_order, individual_legal_act, eu_law, or draft. A code is a law.

name: law_search_acts

issuer.description: The body that adopted the act.

type.description: The document type as the source names it.

url.description: The page of the act at the Legislative Herald.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the results, RFC 3339.

source.description: The source of the data: Legislative Herald of Georgia.

stale.description: True when the source did not answer and the server returns results it read before.

total.description: The count of matching acts at the source.

title: Search the legal acts of Georgia
